name: client_attested_broker_v1
signature_input: Ed25519(DOMAIN || canonical UTF-8 ASCII sorted-key JSON(message))
nonce_semantics: Burned atomically in broker SQLite before witness CAS. Crash gap may lose a request but replay is denied while broker database is retained.
recovery: Direct client SO_PEERCRED permit issuance via witness/authority; broker consumes state-bound one-shot permit before reconciliation and publishes socket only after success
startup_secret_delivery: Inherited file descriptor; token never added to command line or persisted in test logs
kernel_checks: SO_PEERCRED on every IPC hop; OS file owner/private directory checks
library_compatibility: Older Python module and APIs unchanged; new attested_runtime is opt-in for OS-provisioned deployments
no_go: Witness and permit authority share UID
Privileged controller/root can rewrite data and sockets
No production-wide MAC/LSM policy or independent power-failure evidence
